hooks.text: 25万字多视角叙事逐步汇合，需遍历角色命运重构真相
hooks.excerpt: Expansive Storytelling: 250,000+ words of meticulously crafted prose unveil the merciless survival laws of the continent of Hel. Interwoven Perspectives: Employing a multi-POV narrative structure, each chapter advances through distinct protagonists' viewpoints. Initially fragmented storylines gradually converge into a mosaic of revelations. Mystery of Blood and Threads: Truth lies scattered across perspectives like puzzle shards. Only by traversing every character's fate can players reconstruct the ultimate narrative closure.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 卡牌对决随剧情演变，并可把故事角色招募为战斗同伴
hooks.excerpt: 1. Card duels evolve organically with plot developments, forging a symbiotic story-mechanics relationship that deepens narrative immersion. 2. With narrative progression, players will encounter various characters and can recruit some of them as allies during combat.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 可爱舒缓画风搭配200余张剧情CG与叙事配乐
hooks.excerpt: Audio-Visual: Continuing the team's signature cute and soothing art style, with over 200 plot CGs and timeless music that complements the story, providing a heartwarming reading experience.
